headline: Panthers' Brady Tkachuk to donate Senators jerseys thrown in protest
take:
Per ESPN, Brady Tkachuk, who was traded from Ottawa to Florida in June, says he will donate any Senators jerseys thrown onto the ice in protest of his return to the Boys and Girls Club of Ottawa.

On the ice, Tkachuk looks settled in Florida. He has 6 goals and 10 points in 9 games so far this season, after 22 goals and 59 points in 60 games for OTT last year. His own expected goals (a measure of the quality of his shots) come to 4.65, so he is scoring 1.35 above that, a small hot streak but one backed by real chances. At 5-on-5, FLA earns 60.69 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice, and the team's share rises 7.1 percentage points when he plays. For FLA, now 5-2-2, that matters because the team's results have trailed its play: its goals are 1.5 below expected, so Tkachuk's finishing helps close that gap. OTT, 6-3-0, has run the other way, scoring 3.8 goals below expected and carrying a 49 percent 5-on-5 expected goals share, so its record may be flattering it.
